- **Independent health probes:** slow metrics collection no longer blocks the background probe. Completing a scrape no longer overwrites a newer reachability or role observation. After initialization, HTTP health is written only by the probe; `pg_up` and `pg_in_recovery` remain collection results. A reachable database can return `/up` HTTP 200 even when a fatal collector makes `pg_up` zero.

**Search accuracy.** NVD writes the oldest affected branch of a CVE as a range with no lower bound. Searches used to drop such a range whenever another row for the same package had a lower bound, so those versions came back clean. Now the range is dropped only when it looks like a stub: it has a commit-sha bound, has a bound that can't be ordered, repeats the sibling's ceiling, or claims a version the sibling marks as fixed. **Search accuracy.** The floor-less stub guard now works as it does on master. NVD writes a CVE's oldest affected branch as a range with no lower bound, and such a range is now dropped next to a bounded sibling only when it looks like a stub. On the vdbxz:v6.7.x image of 2026-10-23, this brings back 23,274 index rows that were hiding affected versions.
